name: Tose Harumi
source:
She was a junior when Souma was still attending swimming lessons. He was often missed even back then. 

Now, she has grown taller and her chest has expanded to a certain size, making her look different from before.  But she is still a child when it comes to her love life. 

But for the sake of the “Ladies' Alliance", she is trying her best to appeal to Souma, who she has loved for a very long time.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page01.html]official site[/url]]
